description: This file implements the PSR-7 UriInterface, providing a class for URI parsing and manipulation within the Nyholm\Psr7 namespace. It defines the Uri class with methods for constructing, modifying, and converting URIs to strings.

classes.name: Uri
classes.description: A class implementing the PSR-7 UriInterface for parsing and constructing URIs.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a URI object, optionally initialized with a URI string and parsing it into its components.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Converts the URI object back to its string representation.

methods.name: getScheme
methods.description: Returns the URI scheme.

methods.name: getAuthority
methods.description: Returns the authority part of the URI, including user info, host, and port.

methods.name: getUserInfo
methods.description: Returns the user info component of the URI.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Returns the host component of the URI.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port component of the URI in integer form or null if not specified.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the path component, ensuring proper prefixing and slash normalization.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Returns the query string component.

methods.name: getFragment
methods.description: Returns the fragment component.

methods.name: withScheme
methods.description: Returns a new Uri object with the specified scheme.

methods.name: withUserInfo
methods.description: Returns a new Uri object with specified user info and optional password.

methods.name: withHost
methods.description: Returns a new Uri object with the specified host.

methods.name: withPort
methods.description: Returns a new Uri object with the specified port.

methods.name: withPath
methods.description: Returns a new Uri object with the specified path.

methods.name: withQuery
methods.description: Returns a new Uri object with the specified query.

methods.name: withFragment
methods.description: Returns a new Uri object with the specified fragment.

methods.name: createUriString
methods.description: A private static method to assemble components into a full URI string.

methods.name: isNonStandardPort
methods.description: A private static method to determine if a port is non-standard for a given scheme.

methods.name: filterPort
methods.description: Validates and filters the port component.

methods.name: filterPath
methods.description: Validates and filters the path component, URL-encoding as needed.

methods.name: filterQueryAndFragment
methods.description: Validates and filters query and fragment components, URL-encoding as needed.

methods.name: rawurlencodeMatchZero
methods.description: A callback for URL-encoding matched substrings.
